research_question: Does an externally frozen four-asset crypto trend specification retain net OOS Sharpe above 1 on an independent Binance USD-M perpetual archive after realistic execution lag and costs?
hypothesis: Slow trend signals normalized by recent volatility, combined across BTC/ETH/BNB/ADA with shrinkage-covariance risk allocation, retain positive risk-adjusted returns out of sample.

signal.portfolio: max mu*w - 0.5*w'Sigma*w subject to L1(w)<=1; multiply by $10,000 gross cap
signal.execution: target determined from close at t; PnL begins from t+1 return; rebalance every 10 panel days

data.sealed_confirmation_policy: No data after the available August 2026 monthly archive are required or read.

costs.canonical: lagged Abdi-Ranaldo high-low-close spread estimator, 21-day window, charged to absolute dollar turnover
costs.short_carry_stress: 10% annual charge on absolute short notional, accrued daily; reported separately and included in acceptance stress

primary_metric: post-freeze net Sharpe using 252-day annualization under canonical cost + 10% annual short-carry stress

acceptance.must_not_be_single_asset_only: Report asset attribution and concentration; BTC concentration is a risk flag but not an automatic rejection.

trial_accounting: One new strategy trial. Cost cases and carry stress are pre-registered robustness views, not strategy-selection variants.
classification_if_fails: REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE depending on evidence
